tool_args.rationale: The paid pilot has only 0.018 s_grad span, leaving vmax and rho collinear. The authorized guidance explicitly calls for the open_branch_discriminating_probe first, which supplies the leverage needed to identify the branch parameters.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the standard 3-parameter siphon from the initial five rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The narrow s_grad span makes vmax and rho poorly identifiable, so the pilot can mislead despite five measurements.
It costs more and does not specifically resolve the narrow-s_grad collinearity as directly as the open-branch probe.
The observed monotone-concave signature and matched subtree guidance support the siphon family; the targeted probe resolves its stated identifiability issue.
